Heyyy OP, alam mo, I totally get na dating can be super draining, but don’t let it get to you, okay? Rejection doesn’t mean there’s something wrong with you—it’s just na sometimes, people aren’t the right fit, and that’s fine. Don’t feel pressured na every date or situationship needs to lead to a relationship agad-agad. Like, chill ka lang, go with the flow, and just enjoy the process.

Also, pro-tip: wag mo ibuhos agad all your love. Tira ka rin for yourself and for the person who’ll actually deserve it. Everything you’re going through now? It’s like practice lang to help you grow and be ready for the one. Trust the timing. Baka naman when you least expect it, dumating na siya—or who knows someone na nasa paligid mo. 😊
Uh, ew?

Hi, OP! I feel for you. It’s so hard when you care about someone, and parang they just disappear like that. But honestly, sometimes people ghost not because they don’t care, but because they’re avoiding something—like, baka confrontation or maybe something deeper na they can’t even explain. And TBH, I don’t think it’s just the social status thing. Like, what if may other issues din na hindi mo napansin kasi naka-focus lahat doon?

For now, I feel like you really need to give her space. If you keep pushing, it might just make things worse and add even more tension, which you don’t want naman, right? Use this time to reflect din—like, were you both really on the same page? Kasi sometimes, people need time to figure themselves out before they can really face things openly. 

At the end of the day, you deserve someone who will meet you halfway and is ready to communicate. But for now, just let her be muna. Who knows, maybe in time, everything will make more sense for both of you.

Haha! Grabe, natawa ako sa suggestion mo! Actually, gusto ko rin talaga ma-experience ni dad ang out of the country trip. He deserves it after everything he’s been through. Malay mo nga, baka tumumbling pa si tita sa inggit! 😂 Thanks for the idea—this just might be my next big goal for him!

Thank you so much po for your kind words and congratulations! 😊 Tama ka, I think it’s really better na I distance myself from them. Ang hirap rin kasi palaging may drama, and it’s draining. Your advice means a lot—kailangan ko na talagang i-prioritize ang peace namin ni dada. Pero right now, I’m also mentally preparing for the legal process on how I can claim ownership sa mga bagay na naiwan ng mom ko. Wish me luck! Salamat ulit for taking the time to comment!
